verdict.line: You lose if you stand in auto range while Yorick's Last Rites is up or let a Dark Procession wall box you against terrain; you win by poking from 680 range with Toxic Shot and denying his all-ins with Blinding Dart, since Teemo still holds a 52.5% win rate over 1047 games despite Yorick owning the lane and kill pressure.

brief.thesis: Yorick has the lane and solo-kill advantage because Last Rites (Q) gives him a free empowered auto plus self-heal on a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s cooldown and Teemo has no dash or peel to answer a committed melee all-in. Teemo isn't built to win short trades here — he's built to deny them: Blinding Dart (Q) can make that empowered auto miss outright, and Toxic Shot (E) poke at 680 range lets him chip Yorick down without ever entering his attack range. This is a defensive-shape matchup Teemo wins over the long game, not the skirmish.

theirWindow.when: Q (Last Rites) is up and he's closing distance
theirWindow.what: Yorick is walking up for an empowered auto that deals bonus damage and heals him on hit. Back off to max range and don't feed it; if he still commits, land Blinding Dart (Q, 8s cooldown) before his auto connects so the attack misses and he gets neither the damage nor the heal.

yourWindow.when: his Q and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With Last Rites and Mourning Mist down, Yorick has no heal proc and no mark/slow to punish you. Step up and free-hit with Toxic Shot (E, 0 cooldown, 680 range) autos and extend the trade here.

start.why: Doran's Ring (53.4% over 939 games) sustains mana for spamming Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot through early poke exchanges while the potions cover the chip damage from Last Rites pokes.

boots.why: 53.1% win rate over 591 games; the flat movement speed matters more than magic pen for kiting a melee all-in champion with no gap closer of his own.

core.why: Movement speed plus the on-hit proc stacks with Toxic Shot to punish any approach Yorick makes.
Burn damage scales off Toxic Shot's poison uptime and rewards you for kiting rather than trading autos directly.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards landing consecutive Toxic Shot autos at range before Yorick can close distance, and the exposed debuff adds extra damage you can safely cash in from outside his melee range.

summoners.why: Dominant pick at 91.6% with a 52.7% win rate; Ignite punishes his all-in commitment and cuts into the healing from Last Rites, while Flash gets you out from behind a Dark Procession wall.

playing.title: Hold max range always
playing.detail: Stay at 680 range poking with Toxic Shot autos. Yorick has no dash, so every step you don't give him is a step he has to walk for free.

playing.title: Blind his all-in commits
playing.detail: Save Blinding Dart (Q, 8s cooldown) for the moment Yorick commits to an empowered Last Rites auto. Blinding him makes that attack miss, denying both the bonus damage and the self-heal.

playing.title: Dodge the Mourning Mist globule
playing.detail: Mourning Mist (E, 700 range) marks you, slows, damages, and cuts your armor, then speeds his Mist Walkers toward you. Sidestep the throw rather than eating it, since getting marked invites a walker swarm.

playing.title: Respect the wall split
playing.detail: Dark Procession (W, 600 range) can box you against terrain for a follow-up all-in. Don't fight near walls or jungle edges where one wall segment traps you.

playing.title: Seed mushrooms on his engage path
playing.detail: From level 6 on, drop Noxious Trap (R, 1s cooldown, 230 range) along the route Yorick must take to walk up or chase, since the poison cloud slows and burns him for stepping on it.

playing.title: Pop Move Quick on his approach
playing.detail: Trigger W (Move Quick) the instant Yorick starts walking up so your bonus speed isn't stopped by his first auto, letting you kite past his attack range cleanly.

playing.title: Never trade into his heal window
playing.detail: Last Rites heals him on the empowered hit, so avoid trading autos right as his Q comes off cooldown (6/5.5/5/4.5/4s by rank). Wait for it to be down before you commit.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, summoner spells, and all win rates above come from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning on trade timing, cooldown windows, and positioning is my own read of the ability kits, not measured data.
